name: tr100-pure-linux-tools
description: Experimental device-bound TR100 Linux tooling and offline source tests; no firmware binaries

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:policy
scripts.test:node: node --test tools/tests/tcp-file.test.cjs firmware-analysis/tools/tests/tftp.test.cjs firmware-analysis/tools/tests/full-initramfs.test.cjs && node --test --test-name-pattern="eight parts|root superblock|stream engine|gzip verification" firmware-pure-linux/tools/tests/pure-linux-image.test.cjs
scripts.test:policy: node --test-name-pattern="only p8|only one exact|new UUID/tag|handoff writes|marker reader|pure init refuses" -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');if(process.platform!=='win32'){const original=cp.spawnSync;cp.spawnSync=(file,...args)=>original(file==='C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe'?'bash':file,...args);}require('./firmware-analysis/tools/tests/pure-initramfs.test.cjs');require('./firmware-analysis/board-pure-linux/tests/layout.test.cjs');require('./firmware-analysis/board-pure-linux/tests/network-access.test.cjs');require('./firmware-analysis/board-pure-linux/tests/check-rom.cjs');"
